summary: Mangoceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, MangoRx IP Holdings, LLC — holder of the MGX-0024 antiviral patent portfolio — entered Subscription Agreements on September 30, 2026 with two accredited investors to sell a 25% ownership interest for aggregate proceeds of $2,500,000, implying a $10,000,000 valuation for MangoRx IP. Each investor purchases 12.5% for $1,250,000; one pays $500,000 immediately plus $750,000 within 60 days. $1,750,000 has been received and 18.9% (17.5% post-transaction) issued, rising to 25% at final closing. Interests sold under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D; no pro forma required as MangoRx IP is not a business. Watch for the second $750,000 payment and any further subsidiary-level monetization.
